chapters.label: Two–nil down
chapters.text: Turin, April twenty-first, 1999, the Champions League semi-final. Manchester United are two–nil down to Juventus. Captain Roy Keane won’t give up. Beckham swings in a corner... Keane gets there first. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Keane arrives late at the near post, squeezes between two Juventus players, and glances it into the far corner.

chapters.label: Back to work
chapters.text: From behind: past the keeper, in! No big celebration. Keane points to Beckham and runs back to work. United win three–two!

chapters.label: First to the ball
chapters.text: Like Keane: be first to every loose ball, then give a simple pass to a teammate.
